subject.title: [Feature]: [Feature Request] 按用户维度统计 Token 使用量

question: Should OpenClaw core define a stable per-user accounting subject and authorized per-user usage view now, or defer this until broader Gateway identity/accounting design exists?
rationale: The requested billing/quota view crosses identity, authorization, and privacy boundaries that current usage telemetry and the single-operator Gateway trust model do not settle.

options.title: Define Core Accounting Subject
options.body: Add a maintainer-approved accounting subject and viewer-permission model, then extend existing usage RPCs, storage, Dashboard, and command surfaces from that contract.

options.title: Wait For Multi-Principal Design
options.body: Keep the request open but block implementation until Gateway multi-principal and per-message author attribution semantics are settled.

options.title: Use External Reporting For Now
options.body: Treat custom billing dashboards as external diagnostics or plugin/export work until core has a product-approved user accounting boundary.

recommendation.title: Define Core Accounting Subject
recommendation.body: Add a maintainer-approved accounting subject and viewer-permission model, then extend existing usage RPCs, storage, Dashboard, and command surfaces from that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest observed history across provider usage tracking, /usage summaries, shared usage helpers, and the security-sensitive core boundary decision.
